$comment: Copy this file to internal-seed.json and fill in real master data. internal-seed.json is gitignored and never committed. It is loaded by the database seeder when present (dev machines only; the packaged app ignores it). All string fields are optional unless noted.

companies.name: REQUIRED — legal name as it should appear on invoices
companies.notes: e.g. Booking agency - issuer of the German template invoices

bank.accountHolder: Account holder if it differs from the legal name

companies.signatureFile: signature.jpg (file inside sample_data/, optional - shown above the VP1 signature line in contracts)
